S78.01.needs: a Free account (if the plan blocks Skills)
S78.01.note: The resolver itself is packages/contracts/types/src/capability-handshake/evaluator.ts and packages/ui/unified-chat/src/lib/Capabilities.tsx; whether Skills is blocked for Free was not verified.
steps: Open Settings and click Skills.
If the account's plan does not include Skills, read the notice title and text.
Compare with Expected: one decision drives the Skills and Plugins panes and the notice explains the denial.
S78.01.where: Settings > Skills: a plan that is denied Skills shows the notice there

S78.02.note: In code only the effort control changes with the model; the + menu attachment rows do not.
steps: Open a new chat.
Look at the bottom bar of the composer and note whether a Reasoning effort button is there.
Click the model name button and choose a different model from the Models list.
Look at the bottom bar again: the Reasoning effort button should appear, change or disappear according to Expected.
S78.02.where: Composer bottom bar: model name button > Models, then pick a different model

labels.text: The selected model can't read the attached document.

S78.03.needs: a file to upload (PDF or image) and a model that cannot read it
S78.03.note: The file picker accept list is the same for every model (packages/contracts/cloud-contracts/src/chat-attachments.ts, chatAttachmentAcceptAttribute); the model-dependent part is the alert.
steps: Click the + button (Add attachments and tools) and choose Add photos & files; add a PDF or a photo.
Click the model name button and choose a model that cannot read that file type.
Look above the composer for the alert.
Compare with Expected: the alert names the file kind the selected model cannot read.
S78.03.where: Composer: + button (Add attachments and tools) > Add photos & files, then the model name button > a model that cannot read the file

labels.text: Off is not supported by this model

S78.04.note: Removing unsupported levels before sending happens on the server (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts) and is not visible on screen.
steps: Choose a model and click the Reasoning effort button.
Read the levels offered in the panel.
Choose another model, open the panel again and check that only its levels are offered.
On a model where Off is not supported, read the note under the panel.
S78.04.where: Composer bottom bar: Reasoning effort button

S78.06.note: Each video setting button shows only when the model has more than one option for it (ChatComposerNew.tsx); the accessible names are shown, the buttons display the current value.
steps: Use a paid account (Free has no video row).
Click the + button (Add attachments and tools) and choose Create video.
Click the length, quality (Select video quality) and aspect ratio buttons and note the options.
Switch to another video model and compare which buttons and options appear, per Expected.
S78.06.where: Composer: + button (Add attachments and tools) > Create video, then the video setting buttons in the composer

S78.07.needs: a Free account (a paid plan sees fewer locks)
S78.07.note: The server check per route was not exercised from the UI; only the picker's visible lock is covered here.
steps: Sign in with a Free account and open the model picker.
Look for rows with a lock badge: a plan name followed by and above, or Upgrade to use.
Click a locked row and check that it does not switch to that model.
Compare with Expected: plan checks apply to the model here and again on the server.
S78.07.where: Composer bottom bar: model name button > Models list, locked rows

S78.08.needs: a paid or Free account (Free shows only the upgrade card)
steps: Open Settings and click Usage.
Read the This month card and the Plan usage limits card (on Free it reads Upgrade for higher capacity).
Read the remaining figures, which show as a percentage left or None left.
Send a chat message, click Refresh usage data (if shown), and check that the figure moved.

S78.09.needs: a member of a workspace (an owner or admin account to edit)
S78.09.note: Enforcement on chat and other surfaces is server-side (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/route.ts) and not visible as a control.
steps: Open Settings and click Workspace.
Click Workspace administration.
Click Policy in the console menu.
Read the Workspace policy card. An owner or admin sees editable controls; a member reads Only an owner or admin can change these. You are a (role).
Compare with Expected: the rules (for example Zero data retention only) apply to member chats.

S78.10.needs: two accounts in the same workspace: an owner or admin, and a plain member
S78.10.note: The SSO panel is also admin-only (TeamSection.tsx); the server refusal is in apps/web/app/api/settings/team/route.ts.
steps: Sign in as an owner or admin of a workspace and open Settings > Workspace; note the Invite teammate card and the Change role and Remove member actions.
Sign out and sign in as a plain member of the same workspace.
Open Settings > Workspace again.
Compare with Expected: those admin controls are missing for the member, and the server refuses such requests.

labels.text: Only use AI providers based in the US

S78.11.needs: an account for which the switch is enabled (eligibility was not verified)
S78.11.note: Which accounts can use the switch was not confirmed.
steps: Open Settings and click Privacy.
Find the switch Only use AI providers based in the US and turn it on.
Read the line Only US-based providers serve your chats. Models without one are unavailable.
Open the model picker in a new chat and check which models are unavailable, then compare with Expected.
S78.11.where: Settings > Privacy > Only use AI providers based in the US

S78.12.needs: a new account or one without an age decision; a test age under 18
S78.12.note: The quoted lines in RecordTermsAcceptance.tsx and identity/client.ts no longer hold the age check; it now lives in AgeConfirmationStep.tsx.
steps: Create a new account, or sign in to an account that has no age decision yet.
On Confirm your age, type an age under 18 in Your age and press Continue.
Read the screen This account can't be used with the text You must be at least 18 years old to continue.
Type 18 or more on another try and compare with Expected: adults continue.
S78.12.where: Sign-up (new account) or sign-in to an account with no age decision > Confirm your age step

S78.13.needs: a signed-in account with at least one required connector not connected
S78.13.note: If connections cannot be read, the page shows a notice saying it shows what the pack needs instead.
steps: Sign in and open /plugins.
Open a plugin that lists required connectors.
Read the Required connectors list: connected rows show Connected, others show Connect.
Compare with Expected: a missing connection is named and marked with Connect.
S78.13.where: Plugins catalogue (/plugins) > open a plugin > Required connectors

S78.14.needs: none to see the no-desktop case; a paired desktop app to see its status
S78.14.note: The status text appears as a tooltip and screen-reader text, not as a visible label; the status wording comes from apps/web/features/desktop-host/hooks/use-paired-desktop.ts.
steps: Click Code in the app and click More in the rail.
Read Work with local code: with a paired desktop it names the desktop; without one it links to the download page.
Hover the item to read the status (for example is online, is asleep, is offline).
Compare with Expected: the status shows before you rely on the desktop.
S78.14.where: Code (sidebar) > More > Work with local code; a cloud session row menu > Open in > Desktop app

labels.text: Your plan does not include managed environments.

S78.15.needs: a Free account (to see the plan notice)
S78.15.note: Whether the create action is disabled was read from CloudCodePage.tsx (canCreate), not clicked.
steps: Click Code in the app.
With a Free plan, read the notice Your plan does not include managed environments. and the Upgrade button.
If the deployment has managed environments off, the notice reads Managed environments are not enabled on this deployment.
Compare with Expected: the feature is gated and the create action is not offered.
S78.15.where: Code (sidebar) > the cloud session area: notice above the composer

S78.16.needs: none (to see the unavailable state, a model that is temporarily down is needed)
S78.16.note: Whether a model is temporarily down at a given time cannot be predicted from code.
steps: Open the model picker and click All models.
Look for rows marked Temporarily unavailable.
Look for rows marked Not available in this app.
Compare with Expected: the two states read differently; a row can only show one.
S78.16.where: Composer bottom bar: model name button > Models > All models

S78.17.needs: none (to see a model without the effort control, try a few models)
S78.17.note: Which models lack the effort control is not listed in code; the tester has to find one.
steps: Choose a model and look at the bottom bar for a Reasoning effort button.
Choose a model without that control and check the button is gone, not greyed out.
Open the + menu (Add attachments and tools) and check Create image appears only if your plan allows it.
Compare with Expected: irrelevant controls are hidden.
S78.17.where: Composer bottom bar: model name button, then compare two models

steps: With a Free account, click the + button (Add attachments and tools).
Check that the Deep Research row is dimmed.
Hover the Deep Research row and read the reason.
Open the model picker and compare the dimmed rows and badges (Coming soon, Beta) with Expected.
S78.18.where: Composer: + button (Add attachments and tools) > Deep Research (dimmed); model picker rows with badges

labels.text: Upgrade your plan to use it.

S78.19.note: The Not on your plan wording shows in a settings panel (Skills or Plugins) when that pane is denied, not in the composer.
steps: With a Free account, click the + button (Add attachments and tools).
Hover Deep Research and read Upgrade to use Deep Research.
Open the model picker and read the locked row badge, which names the plan (and above).
Compare with Expected: the text names which plan unlocks it and how to upgrade.
S78.19.where: Composer: + button (Add attachments and tools) > Deep Research, and the model picker's locked rows

S78.20.needs: a signed-in account and an outside account for that connector (the connector's own sign-in)
S78.20.note: The row names the connector only; whether it names the account to connect was not confirmed.
steps: Open a plugin that lists required connectors while signed in.
Find a connector that shows Connect.
Click Connect (it links to the connectors page) and connect it.
Return to the plugin page and check the row now shows Connected.
S78.20.where: Plugins catalogue (/plugins) > open a plugin > Required connectors > Connect

S78.21.note: Searched apps/web for microphone and permission copy (use-dictation.ts, VoiceSection.tsx, rg across features, lib and app); found only The microphone could not be started. Try again. and Settings > Voice > Dictation text Speak into the composer with the microphone button. No explanation before the browser prompt was found; the Tool approvals menu in ComposerPlusMenu.tsx was not read for it.

labels.text: The selected model can't read the attached document.

S78.22.needs: a file to upload and a model that cannot read it
steps: Add a PDF or photo with + (Add photos & files).
Choose a model that cannot read that file from the model name button.
Read the alert: it names the file kind and says to switch to Auto or choose a model that can read it.
Click Choose a compatible model to see the models that can read it, then compare with Expected.
S78.22.where: Composer: add a file, then model name button > a model that cannot read it; alert above the composer

S78.23.needs: a paired desktop app to see the continue action (without one, the download page)
S78.23.note: The device bridge contract is packages/contracts/local-runtime/src/host-bridge.ts (no screen of its own).
steps: Click Code in the app and click More.
Click Work with local code: with a paired desktop it opens the desktop; without one it goes to the download page.
Open a cloud session's menu, go to Open in, and click Desktop app.
Compare with Expected: the work continues on the other device or app.
S78.23.where: Code (sidebar) > More > Work with local code; a cloud session row menu > Open in > Desktop app

S78.25.needs: a file to upload and a model that cannot read it
S78.25.note: If no model on the plan can read the file, the list says so and may offer a plan upgrade.
steps: Add a file with + (Add photos & files).
Switch to a model that cannot read it.
In the alert, click Choose a compatible model and pick a model that can read the file (this keeps the file).
Or click Remove attachments (this removes it). Compare with Expected: the user chooses to keep or remove.
S78.25.where: Composer: add a file, then model name button > a model that cannot read it; alert offers Remove attachments and Choose a compatible model

labels.text: Off is not supported by this model

S78.26.needs: none (a model where Off is unsupported is needed)
S78.26.note: Removing unsupported parameters before sending is server-side (apps/web/app/api/llm/v1/chat/completions/lib/request-processor.ts) and not visible.
steps: Choose a model with a reasoning control and click Reasoning effort.
Try to turn thinking off on a model that does not support Off.
Read the note Off is not supported by this model. Using (the level it will use).
Send a message and check that the chat still works, then compare with Expected.
S78.26.where: Composer bottom bar: Reasoning effort button > panel

S78.28.needs: a test account that can change plan
S78.28.note: Billing data refetches on window focus (apps/web/features/billing/hooks/use-billing-queries.ts); the refresh path for the capability decisions was not traced.
steps: Note the locked model rows and the Deep Research row in the composer.
Change the plan in Settings > Billing (Checkout or the billing portal).
Return to the app tab without reloading or restarting.
Reopen the model picker and the + menu and compare the locks and Deep Research row with Expected.
S78.28.where: Settings > Billing (change plan), then return to the chat tab; check the model picker and + menu
